name: 1 Seat Multicolor Children’s Soft Commode Support Toilet Seat 18+ Month | Baby Toilet Seat Safe Soft Training Seat Potty Sitting Ring with Handles Bathroom Trainer Closes tool Cover
description:
Soft Toilet Seat Potty Seat For Kids 
Soft toilet trainer helps your child learn to use the toilet 
The seat is made from soft padded material for extra comfort. It is fitted with two side handles, 
Very stable and adapts to most adult toilets. 
Splash protector and is easy and practical to clean. 
Its small size makes it easy to carry
